points: techconsult survey of 250 German IT decision-makers for eco and EuroCloud Deutschland
63% prefer a European provider for business software, 62% for identity and access management
66% consider a provider or workload change within 12-24 months; only 42% find migration fairly easy
take: A German survey shows sovereignty now shapes AI hosting choices, but switching costs still hold firms back. Useful benchmark for cloud exit and provider shortlists.
title: EuroCloud Pulse Check: 53% plan European clouds for AI
